summary: Feed s110_single is degraded for IDS: encrypted_share is 87.05% exceeding IDS tolerance of 60%, blinding payload inspection. All other visibility checks (duplicates, one-way, VLAN, drops, overload, truncation, tunnel, oversize) are healthy.

findings.root_cause: 87% of bytes are encrypted (TLS) forwarded through packet broker without decryption or selective bypass, exceeding the IDS design threshold of 60%. Broker is mirroring encrypted traffic directly to IDS instead of decrypting or filtering.
findings.impact_on_tool: IDS needs full payload for signature and anomaly detection. With 87% opaque payload, IDS cannot match signatures, perform file extraction or detect exploits in encrypted flows, severely reducing detection coverage and increasing false negatives.

recommended_fix.why: IDS cannot inspect encrypted payload. Deploy SSL/TLS visibility solution or enable selective decryption on packet broker to present cleartext to IDS, or filter/route undecryptable traffic away and monitor decryptable share to stay below 60% threshold.
